sloka: अवसज्य शिलाम् कण्ठे समुद्रम् तर्तुम् इच्छसि ।सूर्या चन्द्रमसौ च उभौ प्राणिभ्याम् हर्तुम् इच्छसि ॥३-४७-४२॥
transliteration: avasajya śilām kaṇṭhe samudram tartum icchasi ।sūryā candramasau ca ubhau prāṇibhyām hartum icchasi ॥3-47-42॥

translations.english: You want to assault Rama's dear wife. It is like girding a stone round the neck and trying to cross the sea.It is like intending to take the Sun and the Moon with both your hands.
